files.permits/README.md:
# Permit archive

The market office moved to the county's new permit portal on 16 September. Paper-era scans (permits issued through 15 September) are all archived under archive/paper-scans/.
Portal-issued permits are exported in batches: the first export covers issues through 24 September (under portal-export/); later issues stay in the county portal until the October batch.
